_comment: Population policy — edit this, not the code. Shipped with the realm, read by both the Populate
Measured, not assumed: a real run over six AXA pages produced 1,604 content elements, and the
crawler had spent its budget on /search, /careers, /markets and a product selector. Chunking
itself is fine — 395 chunks averaged 965 characters with none under 50 — so the waste is whole
IRRELEVANT PAGES, not noisy fragments. Filtering therefore happens at the URL, before ingestion,
where it costs nothing; a page never fetched is chunks never embedded and tokens never spent.
excludePatterns are matched case-insensitively against the full URL as regular expressions.
includeHints only REORDER candidates when more pages are found than the budget allows; they
never exclude, because a sustainability statement can live on a page named anything.
